353800.title: Tightness of the function-field Sárközy bound for square differences
353800.journal_ref: The Quarterly Journal of Mathematics, 2022; haac035
353800.historical_check: No prior campaign note except 355218 (middle-review-r1 n<=8 probe) found by scoped grep of new-twenty-2026-10-31 and new-discoveries-batch2/lanes (*.json,*.md,*.jsonl).
353800.review_depth: Full source LaTeX v3 read (Sections 1-3, all proofs, Conjecture 13 and its context); Green 2017 LaTeX read; four later papers grepped; registries path-screened at live HEADs
353800.summary: Naslund Conjecture 13 (k=2, q odd: Theorem 1 tight, max |A| = q^{3n/4}) is FALSE. Explicit witness: A in P_{5,4} with |A|=160 > 125 = 5^{4(1-1/4)} and no square differences, verified by two independent scripts; Lean draft (UNCOMPILED) uses it. Uniform disproof (Theorem U plus Theorem 3 in CANDIDATE-353800.md): for every prime power q = 1 mod 4 and every n = 0 mod 4 there is a square-difference-free A with |A| = q^{3n/4}(1+1/q+2/q^2). The slice is the level set {4xz-y^2 = nonsquare} (independent because tangent planes are anisotropic) plus one or two square multiples of each isotropic line. Also fails at q=3 for every n = 0 mod 4, n>=8 (computational slice 297 > 243). For q = 3 mod 4 and n = 4 the bound is exact (Hoffman). Exponent 3/4 untouched.
353800.computations: Theorem U checked for q=5,13,17,29,37,41 (0 violations); ILS slices q=5 -> 32, q=9 -> 99, q=13 -> 209, q=17 -> 311, q=3 n=8 -> 297; full verification of q=5 n=8 (|A|=20000 > 15625); k=3 q=7 n=6 -> 637 (< 656.1); k=4 q=5 n=8 -> 1100 (< 1397.5); k=3 q=4 n=6 exact 1280 < 1625.5; exact q=3 n=4 alpha=9; Hoffman q=3,7 exact q^2; q=5 optimum in [32,42], not proved.
353800.remaining: Root/Sol: compile lean/MathDB353800.lean (UNCOMPILED) and audit axioms; independent review of novelty (unread: Le-Liu 2013 Acta Arith.; Link 2008 manuscript; symmetric-bilinear-forms association-scheme literature).

354500.title: Matching conjecture for the Stanley inequality graph
354500.historical_check: No prior campaign note except 355218 (middle-review-r1 n<=8 probe) found by scoped grep of new-twenty-2026-10-31 and new-discoveries-batch2/lanes (*.json,*.md,*.jsonl).
354500.review_depth: Source LaTeX v3 read (final-remarks subsection ss:finrem-GP-injection: graph G and conjecture; section s:restricted: tau_i, delta operator definitions)
354500.summary: Chan-Pak-Panova matching conjecture is false for a trivial reason. In every edge (pi,sigma)-(pi',sigma'), y lies before x in pi' and after x in sigma', so no W-vertex is adjacent to a diagonal pair (tau,tau) in V. Hence a W-saturating matching needs N_{a-1}N_{a+1} <= N_a^2 - N_a. That fails at every Stanley equality case with N_a > 0, e.g. the 3-element antichain (x, a=2: |W|=4, only 2 reachable V-vertices). This contradicts the source's own (equality-case) context; zero-credit defect.
354500.computations: All naturally labelled posets n=3,4,5: matching saturating W fails in 3/6, 86/118, 1999/2281 (x,a) instances.
354500.remaining: none (defect); a repaired graph definition would be a different question.
